title: Pygfx transparency contrast predictor — amber/cyan scene
purpose: Reusable Python module to predict luminance contrast ratios for Iris's three-condition transparency experiment (opaque control, selective transparency A, shared transparency B) before committing to a render. Parameterized so scene colors can be varied to test hypothesis B from the Scout memo: whether color or alpha is the load-bearing variable.
